- **Conclusion:** The underlying paper is real, but two details are suspect: (1) the title uses "Automatic" instead of the correct "Generic," and (2) the EMNLP 2025 Findings venue could not be independently confirmed. It may be an arXiv preprint that has not (yet) been published at EMNLP 2025 Findings, or the BibTeX entry may contain inaccuracies.
